rows.grounds: compound of pañca, ṣoḍhā, and para as given by legacy hint; analyzed as one fused token
compound of nyāsa and ādi with neuter accusative singular ending
optative form, root taken as cav

items.question: How should a five-ṣoḍhā-devoted practitioner perform nyāsa and related rites on that object?
premises: rites are performed on that object
nyāsa and related rites are enjoined
items.inference: The verse enjoins nyāsa and related rites by a five-ṣoḍhā-devoted practitioner on that object.
uncertainties: exact root and conjugation of cavet remain uncertain
precise scope of nyāsādikaṃ is not specified
items.plain_english: Having become five-ṣoḍhā-devoted, one should perform nyāsa and the rest on it.
